# Nines Media

> Nines Media is a full-service digital marketing agency in Johannesburg, South Africa, and a certified Google Partner and Meta Business Partner. Trading name of IMC Media (Pty) Ltd. Based at 1st Floor, Dainfern Square, Cnr William Nicol & Broadacres Dr, Dainfern, Johannesburg, 2191. Phone +27 78 697 5931, email info@ninesmedia.co.za. Serves businesses across South Africa and in the UK, USA, Australia and New Zealand.

Services: Google Ads and PPC management, Meta (Facebook and Instagram) advertising, LinkedIn, YouTube and TikTok advertising, SEO and local SEO, AI search visibility, social media management, lead generation, email marketing, reporting and analytics, branding and brand identity, website design and development, and consulting and training.

Pricing: packages start from R5,000/month (Starter: one paid channel), from R12,000/month (Growth: Google Ads + Meta, social media on two platforms) and from R25,000/month (Full Service). Websites from R15,000, brand identity from R8,000, strategy sprints from R5,000. Every engagement is quoted individually after a free digital marketing audit. Ad spend is billed separately and clients always own their ad accounts. Month-to-month contracts.

How to choose between them, how costs compare in South Africa, and how to split your budget.
